paths.title: The whole course
paths.blurb: Everything, in one order that climbs gradually: the chapters are mixed so a hard exercise never comes right after an easy one.

paths.title: C basics
paths.blurb: Start here if C is rusty: output, variables, operators, input, conditions and loops.

paths.title: Functions, arrays & strings
paths.blurb: Split a program into functions, work with arrays and matrices, and handle text as arrays of characters.

paths.title: Pointers & dynamic memory
paths.blurb: Addresses, pointer arithmetic, and memory you reserve yourself with malloc, realloc and free.

paths.title: Structs & data structures
paths.blurb: Group data in structs and enums, then keep collections of records in memory.

paths.title: Arguments & shell commands
paths.blurb: argc, argv and the environment, then your own versions of wc, cat, cut, sort and friends.

paths.title: Files with stdio
paths.blurb: fopen, fgets, fscanf, fread and friends: read and write text and binary files, then work on their words and lines.

paths.title: System calls & descriptors
paths.blurb: open, read, write, lseek, dup and dup2: files seen as numbers, and redirecting them.

paths.title: Directories
paths.blurb: opendir and readdir, mkdir, chdir and access: look at a directory, then walk a whole tree.

paths.title: Errors & errno
paths.blurb: What fails and why: return values, errno, perror, strerror and exit statuses.

paths.title: Modules, libraries & make
paths.blurb: Split a program into several files, build static and shared libraries, and write a Makefile.

paths.title: Exam-style programs
paths.blurb: Whole programs of the kind the class exercises ask for. Do the chapters you need first, then come here.
